description: [1/4] Plan: fix Palette 0.11.1 resize/export bounds and selection-aware auto levels, re-vendor, move Palette into the Live catalog and out of the top nav, then verify and push.

impact_assessment.why: The editor release is complete but uncommitted; analysis found an uncapped resize path and an export scale that can exceed browser canvas limits; Palette is also a top-level 'Editor' destination instead of a Live app.
impact_assessment.benefits: Prevents memory blowups and failed exports on large documents, keeps monochrome auto levels usable, and surfaces Palette where the other runnable apps live.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: live.json gains a local-build entry with its own path rule; dependency: none; concurrency: uncommitted 0.11.0 vendoring must stay intact; state: autosave/project formats unchanged.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Extend sync_live_apps with a local app branch and tests, keep the Editor page reachable, re-run both suites and gates, and commit the editor release first.

description: [1/2] Re-vendor Palette 0.11.2 and refresh its live manifest entry (version, commit, digest); [2/2] verify the site gates and push.

impact_assessment.why: Palette gained four behavioural fixes after 0.11.1 was published to the Live catalog; the vendored build and its manifest would otherwise drift from the source.
impact_assessment.benefits: The Live build carries the histogram, text, lock and unsaved-document fixes, and its digest matches the served files.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none beyond the existing local live entry; dependency: none; concurrency: sync_live_apps --write can pull Meridian forward again; state: no schema change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Run sync_editor, refresh the manifest, restore unrelated Meridian entries if the write advances them, then re-run both checks and the suite.
